start_state: CACHE: released DepthSplat (re10k+dl3dv base, Gaussian scale cap 0.1) on the 3 context + 4 stream RGB-D views, measured planar depth injected as the final context depth

optimized: per-axis log-scales in each Gaussian's eigenbasis (rotations fixed)
ttt.lr: 3DGS defaults x 1 (means 1.6e-4 x median measured planar depth, log-scales 5e-3, opacity logits 2.5e-2, SH DC 2.5e-3, higher SH 1.25e-4)
ttt.loss: relative L1 of the raw rendered depth on valid measured pixels + 0.5 x RGB L1, on the 7 arrived frames
ttt.failure: a non-finite loss reverts the state to CACHE (as V1)
ttt.branching: SHORT is the state after step 10 of the FULL trajectory, read out before the trajectory continues; the pilot checks it against an independent 10-step run

readout.CORE_B: sqrt(R7 x F7), both floored at 1e-6

cost.measured: CUDA-synchronized seconds per segment, reported but not used in any gate
